affinity.title: affinity
affinity.description: Affinity and anti-affinity rules for pod assignment. See: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/#affinity-and-anti-affinity

enabled.title: enabled
enabled.description: Whether to create a HorizontalPodAutoscaler for kiwix. When enabled, replicaCount is ignored.

maxReplicas.title: maxReplicas
maxReplicas.description: Maximum number of replicas the HorizontalPodAutoscaler will scale up to.

minReplicas.title: minReplicas
minReplicas.description: Minimum number of replicas the HorizontalPodAutoscaler will scale down to.

targetCPUUtilizationPercentage.title: targetCPUUtilizationPercentage
targetCPUUtilizationPercentage.description: Target average CPU utilization percentage used to trigger scaling.

autoscaling.title: autoscaling
autoscaling.description: This section is for setting up autoscaling more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/autoscaling/

fullnameOverride.title: fullnameOverride
fullnameOverride.description: This is to override the fully qualified app name used for resource names.

pullPolicy.title: pullPolicy
pullPolicy.description: This sets the pull policy for images.

tag.title: tag
tag.description: Overrides the image tag whose default is the chart appVersion.

image.title: image
image.description: This sets the container image more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/images/

imagePullSecrets.title: imagePullSecrets
imagePullSecrets.description: This is for the secrets for pulling an image from a private repository more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/pull-image-private-registry/

annotations.title: annotations
annotations.description: Annotations to add to the Ingress resource.

className.title: className
className.description: The name of the IngressClass to use for this Ingress.

enabled.title: enabled
enabled.description: Whether to create an Ingress resource for kiwix.

hosts.title: hosts
hosts.description: List of hosts and their path rules to route to the kiwix service.

tls.title: tls
tls.description: TLS configuration for the Ingress, mapping secretNames to hosts.

ingress.title: ingress
ingress.description: This block is for setting up the ingress for more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/ingress/

livenessProbe.title: livenessProbe
livenessProbe.description: This is to setup the liveness and readiness probes more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-liveness-readiness-startup-probes/

nameOverride.title: nameOverride
nameOverride.description: This is to override the chart name.

nodeSelector.title: nodeSelector
nodeSelector.description: Node labels for pod assignment. See: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/

podAnnotations.title: podAnnotations
podAnnotations.description:
This is for setting Kubernetes Annotations to a Pod.
For more information checkout: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/annotations/

podLabels.title: podLabels
podLabels.description:
This is for setting Kubernetes Labels to a Pod.
For more information checkout: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/labels/

podSecurityContext.title: podSecurityContext
podSecurityContext.description: Security context settings applied to the pod. See: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/

path.title: path
path.description: The path to request on the HTTP server for the readiness check.

port.title: port
port.description: The named container port to probe for the readiness check.

httpGet.title: httpGet
httpGet.description: HTTP GET action used to perform the readiness check.

readinessProbe.title: readinessProbe
readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe configuration for the kiwix container. See: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-liveness-readiness-startup-probes/

replicaCount.title: replicaCount
replicaCount.description:
Number of Deployment replicas to run.

This will set the replicaset count more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/replicaset/

resources.title: resources
resources.description:
Resource requirements for the kiwix container.
- [reference docs](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/kubernetes-api/workload-resources/pod-v1/#resources)
- [schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yannh/kubernetes-json-schema/master/v1.34.0/_definitions.json#/definitions/io.k8s.api.core.v1.ResourceRequirements)
examples:
We usually recommend not to specify default resources and to leave this as a conscious
choice for the user. This also increases chances charts run on environments with little
resources, such as Minikube. If you do want to specify resources, uncomment the following
lines, adjust them as necessary, and remove the curly braces after 'resources:'.
limits:
  cpu: 100m
  memory: 128Mi
requests:
  cpu: 100m
  memory: 128Mi

securityContext.title: securityContext
securityContext.description: Security context settings applied to the kiwix container. See: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/
examples:
capabilities:
  drop:
  - ALL
readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
runAsNonRoot: true
runAsUser: 1000

port.title: port
port.description: The port the Service listens on for the Kiwix container. See https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/#field-spec-ports for more information.

type.title: type
type.description: The Kubernetes Service type to create. See https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/#publishing-services-service-types for more information.

service.title: service
service.description: This is for setting up a service more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/

annotations.title: annotations
annotations.description: Annotations to add to the service account

automount.title: automount
automount.description: Automatically mount a ServiceAccount's API credentials?

create.title: create
create.description: Specifies whether a service account should be created

name.title: name
name.description:
The name of the service account to use.
If not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template

serviceAccount.title: serviceAccount
serviceAccount.description: This section builds out the service account more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/security/service-accounts/

volumeClaimTemplates.title: volumeClaimTemplates
examples:
- metadata:
    name: kiwix-data
  spec:
    accessModes: ["ReadWriteOnce"]
    resources:
      requests:
        storage: 1Gi
    storageClassName: standard

volumeMounts.title: volumeMounts
volumeMounts.description: Additional volumeMounts on the output Deployment definition.

volumes.title: volumes
volumes.description: Additional volumes on the output Deployment definition.
examples:
- name: foo
  secret:
    secretName: mysecret
    optional: false
